query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: High entropy alloys can enhance the wear resistance of a Cu matrix when adhered to its surface.
generation.intervention: Adhering a high entropy alloy to the surface of the Cu matrix
generation.conditions: Application in environments subject to wear and abrasion
generation.structural_mediator: Interface between the high entropy alloy and the Cu matrix
generation.mechanism: The high entropy alloy provides a hard, wear-resistant surface that protects the underlying Cu matrix from wear.
generation.predicted_outcome: Increased wear resistance of the Cu matrix due to the presence of the high entropy alloy.
generation.baseline: Cu matrix without any surface treatment or additional materials.
generation.boundary: The hypothesis is limited to the performance of the Cu matrix in wear resistance applications.
generation.uncertainty: The specific performance characteristics of different high entropy alloys when adhered to Cu are not known.

falsification_experiment.design: Conduct wear tests comparing Cu matrix samples with and without high entropy alloy surface adherence under identical conditions.
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the wear resistance of the Cu matrix with the high entropy alloy is not significantly greater than that of the Cu matrix alone, the hypothesis is falsified.
